title: nhanes-bioimpedance
description:
This repository refits the full 50-frequency bioimpedance spectra from NHANES 1999-2004 (about 13,000 Americans aged 8 to 49) and asks whether the whole spectrum predicts outcomes better than the 50 kHz phase angle that published studies use.

Status: pilot, claimed, not peer reviewed.

Claimed findings include that refitting all 13,276 spectra reproduces CDC's Cole parameters; that a 50 kHz equation predicts DXA lean mass with R^2 ≈ 0.96 on a held-out survey cycle while the full spectrum adds 0.000-0.002; and that in 5,173 adults aged 20-49, 50 kHz phase angle predicts death (hazard ratio 0.66 per degree, adjusted for age and sex) while the full spectrum adds no consistent discrimination.

Code in this archive is under the Apache License 2.0. Text and results are under CC BY 4.0. NHANES data are published by CDC/NCHS and are not redistributed here.

NHANES public-use files and NCHS public-use Linked Mortality Files are not included in this archive. Survey and mortality microdata are downloaded from CDC/NCHS sources listed in the repository and are not committed to git. For any redistribution of the raw NHANES files, follow NCHS/CDC citation and redistribution rules for any redistribution of the raw files themselves. Do not strip NCHS file headers or documentation when redistributing downloaded files. For the Linked Mortality Files, see NCHS data-linkage documentation for permitted use and citation.
